create_swin_transformer_backbone: create a SwinTransformer backbone with configurable depth, embedding dimensions, and attention heads for hierarchical vision feature extraction
build_d2swin_backbone: build a Detectron2 SwinTransformer backbone registered via BACKBONE_REGISTRY with configurable pretrained model parameters
test_window_attention: test the WindowAttention module that performs window-based multi-head self-attention with relative position bias
refactor_basic_layer: refactor the BasicLayer to include cross-view attention contextualization between 2D image features and 3D point cloud data
summarize_patch_merging: summarize the PatchMerging layer that reduces spatial resolution by concatenating neighboring patches and projecting to higher dimension
